note: SPEC §20.19 — the exercises people actually do, named the way a gym names them. scripts/seed-exercises.ts merges this over the open library: `library` renames an existing row (its id never changes, so routines and history keep working; the textbook name stays searchable as an alias) and may correct its muscles or load type; `added` holds mainstream movements the library has no entry for, written by Kalib, with no demonstration yet. Every entry here is marked popular, which is what the picker shows first and what search ranks above obscure variants. `shorthand` is what typing in full names this exercise outright (one owner per phrase, checked at build); `aliases` only help it match.
naming: Movement first, then the implement in parentheses: Bench Press (Barbell), Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell), Lat Pulldown (Cable), Pec Deck (Machine). Movements done with the body alone take no parentheses: Pull-Up, Push-Up, Plank. This is the convention Hevy and Strong use, so a name read in either reads the same here.

added.name: Face Pull (Cable)
instructions: Set a rope on a cable at about head height and hold one end in each hand, thumbs toward you.
Step back until your arms are straight and the weight is off the stack; stand tall with a light brace.
Pull the rope toward your face, driving your elbows high and wide and pulling the ends apart as they pass your ears.
Pause with your hands beside your head and your shoulder blades squeezed together, then let the arms straighten under control.

added.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the edge of a bench and roll a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet flat about hip-width apart, close enough that your shins are vertical at the top.
Tuck your chin, brace, and drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top without arching your lower back, then lower your hips under control.

added.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your upper back on the pad and the hip belt or pad across your hips.
Set your feet flat on the platform so your shins are vertical when your hips are up.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your thighs line up with your body.
Hold the squeeze for a moment, then lower until the weight is almost back on its rest.

added.name: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
instructions: Step into the machine with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet in the middle of the platform about hip-width apart and release the safety.
Bend your knees and let the pad swing down and back until your thighs pass parallel, keeping your heels down.
Drive through the whole foot to swing back up, stopping just short of locking your knees.

added.name: Belt Squat (Machine)
instructions: Fasten the belt around your hips and attach it to the machine, then stand on the platform with feet a little wider than hip-width.
Hold the handles lightly for balance and release the stop so the load hangs from your hips.
Sit straight down between your heels until your thighs are about parallel, chest up.
Stand back up by pushing the floor away, keeping your knees in line with your toes.

added.name: Landmine Press
instructions: Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine base or a corner and load the other end.
Hold the loaded end at shoulder height with one or both hands, standing in a split or square stance.
Press the bar up and forward along its arc until your arm is straight, letting your shoulder blade move with it.
Lower it back to your shoulder under control.

added.name: Floor Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on the floor inside a rack with the bar set at the height of your outstretched arms.
Grip the bar as for a bench press and unrack it over your chest.
Lower until your upper arms rest on the floor, pause briefly, and keep your elbows about 45 degrees from your sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.

added.name: Push Press (Barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar on the front of your shoulders with a grip just outside shoulder width, elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few centimetres by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive hard out of the dip and use that momentum to press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders, absorbing it with your legs.

added.name: Snatch (Barbell)
instructions: Set up over the bar with a wide grip, hips higher than your knees and your back flat.
Push the floor away to lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close.
Extend your hips explosively as the bar reaches your upper thighs, then pull yourself under it.
Catch the bar overhead on straight arms in a squat, then stand up with it.

added.name: Clean and Jerk (Barbell)
instructions: Lift the bar from the floor and extend your hips explosively, pulling yourself under it to catch it on the front of your shoulders.
Stand up out of the catch with the bar in the front rack.
Dip and drive with your legs, then split or push your feet as you punch the bar overhead.
Bring your feet back together under the locked-out bar before lowering it.

added.name: Hang Clean (Barbell)
instructions: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with a grip just outside your legs.
Hinge so the bar slides to just above your knees, back flat.
Extend your hips and knees explosively, shrug, and pull yourself under the bar.
Catch it on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high, then stand tall.

added.name: Skull Crusher (EZ Bar)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar over your chest on the angled grips, arms straight.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Stop when your forearms are about level with the bench.
Straighten your elbows to press the bar back up.

added.name: Bayesian Curl (Cable)
instructions: Set a handle on a low pulley and face away from the machine, holding the handle in one hand behind you.
Step forward until your arm is pulled back behind your body with a stretch in the biceps.
Curl the handle forward and up without letting your elbow drift in front of your body.
Lower it back to the stretch slowly, then switch arms after the set.

added.name: External Rotation (Cable)
instructions: Set a handle at elbow height and stand side-on to the machine, holding it in the hand farther from the stack.
Tuck your elbow against your side, bent to 90 degrees, forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm out and away from your body, keeping the elbow pinned.
Return slowly across your body.

added.name: Split Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each side and take a long step forward into a staggered stance.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, front shin close to vertical.
Push through your front foot to rise, staying in the split stance.
Finish the set on one side before switching legs.

added.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at each side.
Step forward and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back leg straight through into the next step.
Keep alternating legs as you walk forward; count each leg as one rep.

added.name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell by its end between your legs.
Sit your hips down between your heels, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Go as low as you can with a flat back and the dumbbell hanging straight down.
Stand back up by squeezing your glutes and inner thighs.

added.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles anchored under a bar, a partner's hands or a fixed object.
Keep a straight line from knees to head and cross your arms or hold them ready to catch yourself.
Lean forward as slowly as you can, resisting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands when you can no longer hold it, then push back up and pull with your hamstrings to return.

added.name: Toes to Bar
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms and your legs together.
Brace your abs and press the bar down slightly with straight arms.
Lift your legs, keeping them as straight as you can, until your toes touch the bar.
Lower your legs under control, without swinging into the next rep.

added.name: Pallof Press (Cable)
instructions: Set a handle at chest height and stand side-on to the machine, holding the handle against your chest with both hands.
Step away until the cable is tight and set your feet hip-width apart, knees soft.
Press the handle straight out in front of your chest without letting your body twist toward the machine.
Hold for a breath, bring it back to your chest, and switch sides after the set.

added.name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box about a short step away, feet hip-width apart.
Swing your arms back as you dip into a quarter squat.
Jump up and land softly on the box with both feet, knees bent and in line with your toes.
Stand tall on the box, then step down rather than jumping off.

added.name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about two foot-lengths in front of it.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees are over your ankles.
Keep your back flat against the wall and your weight in your heels.
Hold for time, then slide back up.

added.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar overhand, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet so you hang with straight arms and relaxed legs.
Keep a light brace and breathe steadily.
Hold for time, then step down.

added.name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips so your body forms an upside-down V.
Place your hands a little wider than your shoulders, head between your arms.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor in front of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

added.name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a light band in front of your chest with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides, keeping your arms nearly straight.
Stop when the band touches your chest and your shoulder blades are squeezed together.
Let your hands come back together slowly.

added.name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs a few centimetres off it.
Keep your arms by your ears and your legs together; bend your knees to make it easier.
Hold for time without letting your lower back lift.

added.name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side next to a bench and rest the inside of your top leg's knee or ankle on it.
Prop yourself on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body is straight, holding yourself up with the top leg pressing into the bench.
Hold for time, then switch sides.

added.name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Strap your feet in and sit tall with your arms straight, holding the handle.
Push with your legs first, then swing your body back slightly, then pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Reverse the order to return: arms out, lean forward from the hips, then bend your knees.
Keep a steady rhythm; the drive is quick and the return is slower.

added.name: Assault Bike
instructions: Set the seat so your leg is nearly straight at the bottom of each pedal stroke.
Hold the moving handles and pedal, pushing and pulling the handles as your legs drive.
Keep your back tall and breathe steadily.
Raise or lower the effort by pedalling harder; the fan resists more the faster you go.

added.name: Sled Push
instructions: Load the sled and grip the upright handles with your arms extended or bent.
Lean into the sled with a flat back, your body at about a 45-degree angle.
Drive it forward with short, powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Count each length as one rep.

added.name: Cycling (Outdoor)
instructions: Set the saddle so your leg is nearly straight at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Ride at a pace you can hold, shifting gears to keep your cadence steady on hills.
Log the distance and the time.

added.name: Swimming
instructions: Swim at a pace you can hold, with any stroke.
Log the distance and the time.
